meta.name: azure-deploy
meta.description: Execute Azure deployments for ALREADY-PREPARED applications that have existing .azure/deployment-plan.md and infrastructure files. DO NOT use this skill when the user asks to CREATE a new application — use azure-prepare instead. This skill runs azd up, azd deploy, terraform apply, and az deployment commands with built-in error recovery. Requires .azure/deployment-plan.md from azure-prepare and validated status from azure-validate. WHEN: "run azd up", "run azd deploy", "execute deployment", "push to production", "push to cloud", "go live", "ship it", "bicep deploy", "terraform apply", "publish to Azure", "launch on Azure". DO NOT USE WHEN: "create and deploy", "build and deploy", "create a new app", "set up infrastructure", "create and deploy to Azure using Terraform" — use azure-prepare for these.

copy.tagline: 把已经准备好的应用发布到云端,出错自动恢复继续部署

copy.tagline_en: Ship a ready app to the cloud and recover automatically when a deploy step fails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your app is finished and only needs to be pushed to production.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取 .azure/deployment-plan.md 并确认状态为 Validated,按配方执行 azd up、azd deploy 等部署命令,带内置错误恢复,最后把端点以完整 https:// 链接报给你。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads .azure/deployment-plan.md, confirms status is Validated, then runs azd up, azd deploy and similar commands per the recipe with built-in error recovery, and reports endpoint URLs as full https:// links.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like “run azd up”, “execute deployment” or “push to production”, or want to deploy an app that already has .azure/deployment-plan.md. Not for creating new apps.

say_en.text: Run azd up and deploy the prepared app to Azure
say_en.note: Checks plan status, then runs the recipe

say_en.text: Execute the deployment and push the built code to production
say_en.note: Runs pre-deploy checks and error recovery

say_en.text: Run terraform apply and give me the endpoint links when done
say_en.note: Reports results as full https:// links
